prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: compact academic presentation illustration of proposed room sampling, for a white-background SimuNow technical-method slide.
Primary request: a single compact office in a raised isometric cutaway view, showing four occupied-seat sampling locations as neutral teal points.
Scene: rectangular small office with exactly four desks and exactly four chairs arranged in two by two pattern, computers, one window on left wall, one door on rear wall, exactly one high-mounted split air conditioner on rear wall. Low cutaway walls on front and right to reveal furniture. No people.
Sampling markers: exactly four small cyan/teal spheres, each clearly located just above one of the four chair seats, at an illustrative seated occupant position. The four markers are simply sample-location markers, not physical particles, airflow, temperatures, or a simulation result. No marker on a desk or inside furniture.
Style: crisp architectural study model, white walls, pale grey floor, restrained neutral surfaces, soft realistic ambient occlusion, subtle teal (#277F89 and #57BCC7) accents. Fine edges and elegant academic aesthetic matching preceding architectural office illustrations.
Composition: approximately 4:3 landscape canvas, one complete room centred and filling the frame, elevated front-right isometric camera angle that keeps all four seat markers and chairs visible. Pure white backdrop and minimal outer margins. Gentle shadows only. No image frame or panel.
Text: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logo or watermark. Editable annotations will be added in PowerPoint.
Constraints: geometry and sampling concept only. No heat map, colour gradient, streamlines, flow vectors, CFD grid, measured data, chart, performance values or comfort success colours. Exactly four desk/chair stations and four teal sample points.
scope: Hypothetical geometry and occupied-seat sample markers, not computed fields or measured performance.
